intro: Nouns whose meaning changes with their gender, nouns that never change, and awkward plurals.
p.orden.consejo: «El orden» is having everything in its place; «la orden» is a command. The article changes the meaning.
p.capital.consejo: «El capital» is invested money; «la capital» is the main city of a country.
p.pendiente.consejo: «El pendiente» is an ear jewel; «la pendiente» is sloping ground.
p.frente.consejo: «La frente» is above the eyes; «el frente» is the front, or a cold front of the weather.
p.cometa.consejo: «El cometa» passes through the sky; «la cometa» is flown by a child on a string.
p.coma.consejo: «La coma» is the sign (,); «el coma» is a medical state of unconsciousness.
p.editorial.consejo: «La editorial» publishes books; «el editorial» is the opinion article of a newspaper.
p.testigo.consejo: It works for a man and a woman: «el testigo», «la testigo». Only the article changes.
p.víctima.consejo: It is always feminine, even for a man: «Juan fue la víctima». It has an accent on the i.
p.personaje.consejo: It is always masculine, even for a woman: «el personaje». It ends in -e.
p.crisis.consejo: It is feminine and does not change in the plural: «la crisis», «las crisis».
p.régimen.consejo: In the plural the stress moves: «régimen» → «regímenes». The accent stays.
b1.texto:
**Same word, two genders, two meanings.** The article is the only clue: **el orden** (tidiness) and **la orden** (a command); **el capital** (money) and **la capital** (city); **el pendiente** (earring) and **la pendiente** (slope); **el frente** (front) and **la frente** (forehead); **el cometa** (comet) and **la cometa** (kite); **el coma** and **la coma**; **el editorial** (article) and **la editorial** (publisher).

**Trees and fruit.** The tree is masculine, the fruit feminine: **el manzano** / **la manzana**; **el naranjo** / **la naranja**; **el cerezo** / **la cereza**.

**One form for both sexes.** The article changes: **el / la testigo**, **el / la periodista**, **el / la cantante**, **el / la joven**.

**One gender for both sexes.** The article does not change: **la víctima**, **la persona**, **el personaje**, **el bebé**. You say **Juan fue la víctima**.

**Feminine endings.** Nouns in **-ción**, **-sión**, **-dad**, **-tad**, **-tud**, **-ez** and **-umbre** are feminine: **la costumbre**, **la timidez**, **la actitud**.

**Masculine in -ma.** Many words of Greek origin: **el problema**, **el tema**, **el sistema**, **el clima**, **el idioma**, **el programa**.

**Plurals.**

- Words in **-s** with the stress before the last syllable do not change: **la crisis** / **las crisis**; **el análisis** / **los análisis**; **el lunes** / **los lunes**.
- Words ending in stressed **-í** or **-ú** take **-es** or **-s**: **esquí** → **esquís** or **esquíes**.
- The stress moves in a few: **el régimen** → **los regímenes**; **el carácter** → **los caracteres**.
b2.f0.texto: I've received an order from the boss.
b2.f1.texto: He wants tidiness in the warehouse before Monday.
b2.f3.texto: The publisher wants the editorial from me by tomorrow.
b2.f5.texto: It is on the two crises of this year.
b2.f6.texto: The main victim, according to the analyses, has been small business.
b2.f8.texto: Last time the proofreader gave you the text back full of corrections.
b2.f9.texto: There are characters in this office who forgive nothing.
b4.titulo: Gender and plural, case by case
b4.texto:
- **Gender changes the meaning**: el orden / la orden, el capital / la capital, el pendiente / la pendiente, el frente / la frente, el cometa / la cometa, el coma / la coma, el editorial / la editorial.
- **One gender for both sexes**: la víctima, el personaje.
- **One form for both sexes**: el / la testigo, el / la periodista.
- **Plural that does not change**: la crisis → las crisis, el análisis → los análisis.
- **The stress moves**: régimen → regímenes.
b4.e1.texto: The country has lived through several crises.
b4.e2.texto: The witness saw the red kite.
b5.f0.texto: A red kite climbs through the sky above the slope of the meadow.
b5.f1.texto: The wind pulls at the string with a soft, steady strength.
b5.f2.texto: A boy with a broad forehead runs downhill with his arms open.
b5.f3.texto: A cold breeze blows from the front of grey clouds in the north.
b5.f4.texto: A shepherd, a silent witness of the scene, smiles beside his dog.
b5.f5.texto: The kite dances, tilts and climbs again like a free bird.
b5.f6.texto: Its long tail draws signs in the air, like a giant comma.
b5.f7.texto: On the grass, a book from the valley publisher waits open.
b5.f8.texto: With no crises or hurry, the afternoon stretches like a lazy cat.
b5.f9.texto: All the order in the world fits in that small, bright meadow.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «la capital» is the main city.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «El capital» is money, not a city.
b6.o2.refuerzo: It is plural, but Spain has one capital.
b6.pregunta: Choose the gender of the main city.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Víctima» does not change gender with the sex.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That form does not exist in Spanish.
b7.pregunta: Pedro is a man. Which sentence is correct?
b8.frase: El país ha vivido varias crisis
b8.traduccion: The country has lived through several crises
b9.frase: El fruto del ____ es la manzana.
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the tree is masculine, «el manzano».
b9.o1.refuerzo: That is the fruit, not the tree.
b9.o2.refuerzo: It is not the word for the tree.
b11.o0: dos joyas, una de cada sexo
b11.o0.refuerzo: No: the gender changes the meaning, not the sex.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Well done: the gender changes the meaning.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «El pendiente» is not a mountain, but a jewel.
b12.frase: Hay dos ____ de comida muy distintos.
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the stress moves one syllable and the accent stays.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It keeps the accent where it was; the stress moves.
b12.pregunta: The stress moves in the plural.
b12.titulo: The plural that moves the stress
p.recibido.consejo: Participle of «recibir», to receive. The c before i is th in Spain.
p.corrector.consejo: Masculine, «el corrector», from «corregir». The rr is strong.
p.devolvió.consejo: Past tense of «devolver», to give back. The ió is a diphthong.
p.texto.consejo: Masculine, «el texto». The x sounds ks. Stress on TEK.
p.correcciones.consejo: Plural of «corrección». The -ción ending takes the stress.
p.personajes.consejo: Plural of «personaje», character. The j sounds like h.
p.perdonan.consejo: From «perdonar», to forgive. Stress on DO.
p.pedro.consejo: A man's name, written with a capital letter. Stress on PE.
p.tira.consejo: From «tirar», to pull. Stress on TI: TI-ra.
p.baila.consejo: From «bailar», to dance. The ai is a diphthong: BAI-la.
p.inclina.consejo: From «inclinar», to tilt. Stress on KLI: in-KLI-na.
p.signos.consejo: Plural of «signo», sign. The g before i is hard here: SIG-nos.
p.gigante.consejo: The g before i is h. Stress on GAN: hi-GAN-te.
p.prisas.consejo: Plural of «prisa», hurry, used in «sin prisas». Stress on PRI.
p.perezosa.consejo: Feminine of «perezoso», lazy. The z is th in Spain.
p.fruto.consejo: Masculine, «el fruto». Stress on FRU: FRU-to.
p.manzano.consejo: Masculine, «el manzano». The z is th. Stress on THA.
p.comida.consejo: Feminine, «la comida». Here «comida» is the food or the meal.
p.regímenes.consejo: Plural of «régimen», diet. The g is h and the accent is on the e.
